Through: 
 
 
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR OHRI  ORDER % 13.08.2024 CRL. MA 23985/2024 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed.
1. By way of present application, the petitioner/applicant seeks regular bail in FIR No.178/2024 registered under Sections 363/376 IPC & Section 04 of POCSO Act at PS Mangol Puri, Delhi.
2. Issue notice.
3. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file the Status Report.
Let the same be placed on record before the next date of hearing, which shall also indicate the previous involvements of the applicant, if any.

He on instructions from the IO further states that the prosecutrix has shown her inability to engage a counsel and requests that a counsel may be provided to her at State expense to represent her in the present matter.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/08/2024 at 03:18:03 4.
Accordingly, Ms. Shreya Sethi, Advocate (Mob. 9818666566), who is present in Court, is appointed as the Amicus Curiae to represent the prosecutrix/complainant in the present case.
